oneParagraph: The served cityLimitsFact.queryPoint is NOT written by any factory job into parcel_record: parcel_record has no point/coordinate rail at all (65 rails enumerated live, none carries a coordinate; parcel_record_cell has no queryPoint key, and the FILL_OWNED_RAIL_KEYS allowlist this mission's own worktree pins contains no point). The served point is the tier1 bake's coordinate index -- place_layer_snapshots.lat_rounded/lng_rounded for adapter node-facets:tier1 -- which LDT's brokerageNodeFacets turns into queryPoint via usableCityLimitsQueryPoint(lngRounded, latRounded) and hauska-map's record patch then carries through unchanged (withPreservedQueryPoint). That coordinate is computed by legacy-design-tools' nodeFacetBakeTier1ConformantCli.ts:955-958 as ringCentroid(firstRing(row.geometry)) where row = crosswalkRow ?? situsRow, and on gate-blocked Hays crosswalkRow is selected by crosswalkKeyByPropId.get(NODE prop_id) -- a map keyed by the CAD ROLL's bare prop_id. Hays node 97658's bare digits are also a real 2026 CAD account (R128076) whose published property_number is 11-0362-000E-01500-4, which names txgio_parcel 128076 = 13669 MESA VERDE DR, 34.8 km from the Sturgeon lot. All five Sturgeon nodes reproduce this to 5 decimal places. The rule (node's own TxGIO polygon wins the geometry on a gate-blocked county) is implemented in the bake, not in the factory.

Every one of them is written by a hauska-factory job that reads the node's OWN txgio_parcel.geom by prop_id -- which is why the served cityLimits ('San Marcos') and flood (zone AO, method 'point-on-surface') are correct while the bake's queryPoint is 34.8 km away.

theRule.statement: On a gate-blocked county (SEED_BLOCKED_FIPS: 48209 Hays, 48491 Williamson) the bake's coordinate index must come from the node's OWN txgio_parcel row -- matched by (county_fips, prop_id), the identity law's parcel-map id, the same row the factory's flood/school/utility/overlay/watershed jobs and P-180's own exclusion probe already use -- taken before any published-identifier crosswalk bind or situs recovery. The bare-number CAD lookup (crosswalkKeyByPropId keyed by node prop_id) and the situs recovery keyed off a colliding account must never be able to win a coordinate.
theRule.whyGeometryFirst: It exists for every node (P-180 drops only nodes with no txgio row at all, before this point), it is the same source the flood cell uses, and it cannot be reached through a numbering collision: txgio_parcel.prop_id is the node's own identity by the declared-roll ruling.
theRule.nonBlockedCountiesUnchanged: The change is inside the joinGateBlocked branch only; for 48021/48055/48309/48453 the code path is byte-identical (propIdRow, as today).

contradicted: The dispatch says the writer lives in hauska-factory (worktrees hauska-factory-p183-querypoint, branch fix/p183-geocoded-cells-crosswalk) and that the record store's geocoded cells were computed from the CAD situs joined by bare number. MEASURED: parcel_record/parcel_record_cell hold no coordinate for these nodes at all (they carry 65 rails; cityLimits is a scalar city name and parcelGeometry is kind 'unaccounted'), and no hauska-factory job writes a point into the record store. The only bare-number-joined coordinate is the LDT bake's, so the fix is a legacy-design-tools change plus a hauska-factory _LDT_SHA bump (exactly the shape P-178 used in #146).
The dispatch's alternative home, hauska-engine, has no queryPoint token anywhere in the repo (grep, 2026-09-14) -- the engine cannot be the reader that composes this point.

The dispatch lists 'the bake and its walk (the P-178 publish lane)' as out of scope, yet the value to fix is written by the bake's coordinate index. I am treating the CODE of the bake as in-lane (the value cannot be fixed anywhere else) and the P-178 publish/walk as the other lane's, reporting this rather than silently widening scope.

P-177's own comment (nodeFacetBakeTier1ConformantCli.ts:504-531) claims 'P-175's own crosswalk fix only ever affected which RING a node draws; it never touched this lookup, which is why the served label and dollars never changed' -- the first half is wrong for a blocked county: P-175's crosswalk fix is exactly what re-pointed the RING at the colliding account's parcel.
